summary.summary: On 2026-01-23 two unusual login events were flagged on auth-service within about a minute of each other. Both involved users logging in from IP addresses they have never used before; the first was a single INFO‑level alert, the second was marked HIGH because it occurred at 19:00 UTC, a time the user never logs in. Each user’s history shows dozens of prior successful logins (87 and 122) from only two known sources, making these new sources highly anomalous.
